expectations.text: Treats the common 70/30 practice and the 50/50 move as conditional heuristics (justified only when traffic is high and conversion is the bottleneck), overridden here by the pool-bound ceiling
expectations.evidence: The override half is clearly satisfied: the 50/50 ask is labelled the 'Naive "board" ask' in the split table and explicitly displaced by ceiling math ('the pool math caps retargeting near 7% regardless'; 'retargeting spend is bounded by pool × frequency cap × CPM, not by ambition — this is the binding constraint, not a target to negotiate'). But the heuristic half is missing: the 70/30 industry-standard baseline is never named or discussed anywhere, and the answer never states the conditions under which a 50/50 (or heavier-retargeting) split would legitimately apply — i.e. high traffic volume
